meta.description: Keep the latest registration record per customer.
meta.sql:
-- 客户主表：每个客户号保留最新一条注册记录
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE demo_dwd.dwd_party_customer_info_df PARTITION (dt = '${bizdate}')
SELECT customer_id, verified_customer_no, gender_cd, register_time, verify_status, etl_time
FROM (
    SELECT cust_no AS customer_id,
           verified_no AS verified_customer_no,
           gender AS gender_cd,  -- F 女, M 男, U 未知
           from_unixtime(register_ts) AS register_time,
           verify_flag AS verify_status,  -- 1 已实名, 0 未实名
           current_timestamp() AS etl_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_no ORDER BY update_ts DESC) AS rn
    FROM demo_ods.ods_core_customer_df
    WHERE dt = '${bizdate}'
) latest
WHERE rn = 1
